license_required.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

name.quote: "Board" means the Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter.

type.quote: Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine or equivalent from accredited school
degree_required.quote: Has received a degree from a school or college of podiatric medicine or chiropody recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association. For applicants who matriculated prior to 1953, the course of study shall have been at least 3 years. For applicants who matriculated during or subsequent to 1953, the course of study shall be at least 4 years or the total hourly equivalent of a 4-year course of study.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: recognized and approved by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

required.quote:
Has satisfactorily completed one of the following clinical experience requirements:
1. One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

duration.value: 1 year residency or 10 years active licensed practice in another state
duration.quote:
One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board... or successful completion of a board-approved postgraduate program or board-approved course within the year preceding the filing of the application. For the purpose of this subparagraph, "active licensed practice" means the licensed practice of podiatric medicine as defined in s. 461.003(5) by podiatric physicians, including podiatric physicians employed by any governmental entity, on the active teaching faculty of an accredited school of podiatric medicine, or practicing administrative podiatric medicine.
2. Ten years of continuous, active licensed practice of podiatric medicine in another state immediately preceding the submission of the application

kind.value: podiatric residency or active licensed practice
kind.quote: One year of residency in a residency program approved by the board

exams.name: Licensure Examination
exams.quote: The department shall examine each applicant who the board certifies

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: a fee not to exceed $350 set by the board

required.quote: The board may by rule prescribe continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license, with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances.

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially

value: 2 hours on safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances
topical_requirements.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

available.quote: Ten years of continuous, active licensed practice of podiatric medicine in another state immediately preceding the submission of the application and completion of at least the same continuing educational requirements during those 10 years as are required of podiatric physicians licensed in this state.

requirements.value: 10 years continuous active licensed practice in another state with same continuing education requirements
requirements.quote: Ten years of continuous, active licensed practice of podiatric medicine in another state immediately preceding the submission of the application and completion of at least the same continuing educational requirements during those 10 years as are required of podiatric physicians licensed in this state.

exists.quote: Board of Podiatric Medicine as created in this chapter

national_certification.value: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME)
national_certification.quote: passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)

national_association.quote: Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

regulatory_model.quote: Any person desiring to be licensed as a podiatric physician shall apply to the department to take the licensure examination.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue a license to practice podiatric medicine to any applicant who successfully completes the examination in accordance with this section.

is_mandatory.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license or with a license fraudulently obtained.

title_protection.quote: Using the name or title "Podiatrist," "Doctor of Podiatry," or "Doctor of Podiatric Medicine" or using the phrase "foot clinic," "foot doctor," "quiropedista," or any other name, title, or phrase which would lead the public to believe that such person is engaging in the practice of podiatric medicine unless such person is licensed as a podiatric physician in this state.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice podiatric medicine without an active license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license to practice podiatric medicine by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice podiatric medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime that directly relates to the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, of a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of podiatric medicine or to the ability to practice podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report any person known to be in violation of the chapter or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, permitting, or advising any unlicensed person to practice podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, permitting, or advising any unlicensed person to practice podiatric medicine contrary to this chapter or to rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed podiatric physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed podiatric physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report known to be false or intentionally failing to file required reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of podiatric medicine or employing a trick or scheme in the practice of podiatric medicine when such scheme or trick fails to conform to the generally prevailing standards of treatment in the podiatric community.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients either personally or through an agent unless approved by board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients either personally or through an agent, unless such solicitation falls into a category of solicitations approved by rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written medical records justifying the course of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written medical records justifying the course of treatment of the patient, including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination results, and test results.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on patient to exploit for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on the patient or client in such a manner as to exploit the patient or client for financial gain of the licensee or of a third party which shall include, but not be limited to, the promotion or sale of services, goods, appliances, or drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services not duly authorized by the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client or her or his legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, administering controlled substances inappropriately or in excessive quantities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including all controlled substances, other than in the course of the podiatric physician's professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances to oneself
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893 by the podiatric physician to herself or himself except those prescribed, dispensed, or administered to the podiatric physician by another practitioner authorized to prescribe, dispense, or administer them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing amphetamine or sympathomimetic amine Schedule II controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving any amphetamine or sympathomimetic amine drug or compound designated as a Schedule II controlled substance pursuant to chapter 893.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance abuse, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated malpractice or failure to practice at recognized standard of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated malpractice or the failure to practice podiatric medicine at a level of care, skill, and treatment which is recognized by a reasonably prudent podiatric physician as being acceptable under similar conditions and circumstances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing procedure or prescribing therapy constituting experimentation without informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of podiatric medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that she or he is not competent to perform.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to unqualified person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the licensee delegating such responsibilities knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring with another licensee to coerce, intimidate, or preclude lawful advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with another licensee or with any other person to commit an act, or committing an act, which would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising her or his services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing growth hormones or testosterone for muscle building or athletic enhancement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving growth hormones, testosterone or its analogs, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), or other hormones for the purpose of muscle building or to enhance athletic performance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report physician or osteopathic physician violations in licensed facilities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any licensee under chapter 458 or chapter 459 who the podiatric physician knows has violated the grounds for disciplinary action set out in the law under which that person is licensed and who provides health care services in a facility licensed under chapter 395, or a health maintenance organization certificated under part I of chapter 641, in which the podiatric physician also provides services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with patient rights notification requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of ss. 381.026 and 381.0261 to provide patients with information about their patient rights and how to file a patient complaint.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the chapter or rules adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical, palliative, and mechanical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

drug_authority.value: A podiatric physician may prescribe drugs that relate specifically to the scope of practice authorized
drug_authority.quote: A podiatric physician may prescribe drugs that relate specifically to the scope of practice authorized herein.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg shall be limited anatomically to that part below the anterior tibial tubercle.

amputation_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine shall include the amputation of the toes or other parts of the foot but shall not include the amputation of the foot or leg in its entirety.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A podiatric physician may prescribe drugs that relate specifically to the scope of practice authorized herein.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A podiatric physician who is supervising a medical assistant shall be governed by s. 458.3485.

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: a certified podiatric X-ray assistant to operate such equipment and expose such films under the licensed podiatric physician's direction and supervision, pursuant to rules adopted by the board in accordance with s. 461.004, which ensures that such certified podiatric X-ray assistant is competent to operate such equipment in a safe and efficient manner by reason of training, experience, and passage of a board-approved course which includes an examination.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: the Board of Podiatric Medicine...shall, by rule, require that all health care practitioners licensed under the respective board...maintain medical malpractice insurance or provide proof of financial responsibility in an amount and in a manner determined by the board or department to be sufficient to cover claims arising out of the rendering of or failure to render professional care and services in this state.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall not prohibit the manufacture, advertisement, or sale of proprietary corrective shoes, foot appliances, or remedies.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: a person who the licensee knows is unable to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition, may be reported to a consultant operating an impaired practitioner program as described in s. 456.076
